description: direction/sequence_plan.json -- the canonical, hand-authored table of which claims get a real, materialized evidence-asset image instead of a native (concept_map/comparison/source_timeline/source_article/evidence_chain/boundary) card. This is deliberately narrow: scripts/orvyq_full_production_plan.mjs's existing FOOTAGE_ASSIGNMENTS / GRAPHIC_BREAK_ASSIGNMENTS / SLICE_COUNT_OVERRIDES tables are ALREADY real, hand-authored, non-mechanical sequence-level editorial decisions (no automatic evidence->context->metaphor rotation, no every-third-slice rule -- see that file's own header) with extensive load-bearing rationale comments explaining exactly why each real CI-confirmed edge case was resolved the way it was; migrating them into JSON would strip that documentation for no functional benefit and risk destabilizing a delicate, thoroughly-tested algorithm. evidence_kind_overrides is the one genuinely new mechanism this file adds: routing a specific claim's evidence shot(s) to a real materialized document/figure/screen image (schemas/evidence_asset_manifest.json / research/primary_evidence_manifest.json) instead of kindFor()'s NATIVE_KINDS-only default, which is the confirmed, structural reason the rejected review contained zero real evidence assets.

evidence_kind_overrides.description: Keyed by claim_id. Applies to every one of that claim's slices that would otherwise default to a NATIVE_KINDS card (i.e. slices with no FOOTAGE_ASSIGNMENTS or GRAPHIC_BREAK_ASSIGNMENTS entry of their own). distinct_image_per_occurrence rotates one real image per later occurrence; first_occurrence_asset_count may reserve a small opening set when the project profile explicitly requires multiple documents or figures in the first post-hook evidence shot.

distinct_image_per_occurrence.description: When true, each later native evidence slice gets exactly one image, cycling through the declared evidence_asset_ids/image_assets instead of attaching the full set on every slice.

first_occurrence_asset_count.description: Optional number of declared real assets attached together only to occurrence zero. Later occurrences still follow distinct_image_per_occurrence rotation, offset past the opening set so per-source reuse remains bounded.
